compute.basis: No code is released; the Choquet/C-alpha-C aggregation with Poisson moving-average fuzzy measure and the exact preprocessing/splits must be reimplemented from the paper, then RF trained on ~693k rows x 79 cols (reduced to 10 features) on CPU.

blockers: No code or configs released; aggregation pipeline (copula choice, alpha, fuzzy measure, window W) must be reverse-engineered
